_about: Extra public versions of each series' Best Team (built ONCE per season, after the main teams; never rebuilt nightly). 'exclude': without those cards (every level of an LTM / regular Evo; Elite Evos stay in); if the main team already has none of them it is reused. 'include': with extra cards ('evos_all' = every possible standard Evo card of the game year, one card per Evo). '*' = every series. A rule field ending in '_has' matches part of the value ({'color_has': 'draft'} = any Draft League card).
